description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiribamunegama, Polpithigama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. (24/0813)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring title ownership for multiple land parcels in various locations. The content focuses on land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
